citation_details.title: Visual imagery EEG dataset from Gao et al 2026
citation_details.author: Jing’ao Gao, Yao Liu (173014), Zhengshuang Li, Kaixin Huang, Fan Wang (135182), Jiaping Xu, Lei Zhao, Tianwen Li, Yunfa Fu
citation_details.abstract: A 32-channel EEG dataset comprising visual imagery recordings from 22 healthy participants performing mental imagery tasks of 10 distinct categories (animals, geometric figures, and objects). The dataset contains 16,800 trials collected across 2 sessions per subject with simultaneous EEG acquisition at 1000 Hz, designed to support brain-computer interface research and classification algorithm development.
